title: Sasaki with torsion manifolds and string backgrounds
summary: Motivated by the analogy with the Bismut connection in Hermitian geometry, we study Sasaki with torsion manifolds. In particular, we characterize co-Kähler-like and flat Sasaki with torsion manifolds, and we introduce the notion of a $\nabla$-Einstein manifold as the odd-dimensional analogue of the Bismut Hermite-Einstein condition. We provide non-compact examples and we study compact $\nabla$-Einstein manifold in dimension $5$ and $7$. We also develop a general framework for geometric flows of almost contact metric structures.
